findings.issue: The summary identifies iteration 10 as the cap and later records a stop, but production code was still changed and published in iteration 13 after twelve review reports existed. Later close ticks made no production changes but cannot undo the cap violation.
findings.consequence: Another implementation tick in this workflow would violate the governing instruction and add post-cap work.
findings.correction: Stop this loop after this review, preserve the published linear history without reset/revert/force operations, and carry product findings into a separately authorized run.

findings.criterion: 7 and cross-cutting security — mandatory idempotency for Super Admin tenant creation
findings.issue: POST /v1/platform/tenants is replaySafe rather than idempotent, so keyless writes execute. Retrying a keyless request after a lost response reruns no-slug provisioning, whose collision path creates a random-suffixed tenant.
findings.consequence: One intended Super Admin action can create two properties with owner memberships, inventories, policies, and audit history.
findings.correction: Require Idempotency-Key on tenant creation, update callers/tests, assert keyless rejection and exact-key replay of one property, and add rendered Platform-form retry/in-flight coverage.

findings.criterion: 7 and cross-cutting data integrity — atomic, recoverable platform idempotency
findings.issue: Reservation, business mutation, and response finalization are separate autocommits with no lease, reconciliation, or durable operation identity. Failure after the mutation commits leaves status=0 permanently; exact retry returns request_in_progress while a fresh key can create a random-suffixed duplicate.
findings.consequence: A successfully created property can be permanently stranded or duplicated during recovery.
findings.correction: Atomically bind completion/result identity to the mutation, or persist an operation ID on the resource that reconstructs a stale reservation. Add post-business-commit fault injection proving retry returns one committed property.

findings.criterion: 6 and 7 — recoverable local-auth person and owner onboarding
findings.issue: Local creation delivers its only temporary password in the first response, while replay stores temporaryPassword as null. After a committed request whose response is lost, replay returns 201 without a credential, the UI reports an invitation that local auth never created, and local auth exposes no recovery path.
findings.consequence: A created person or newly created property's only owner can exist but be unable to sign in.
findings.correction: Use a recoverable setup/invitation or authenticated credential-reset mechanism with an explicit replay outcome while keeping secrets out of replay storage. Test lost-response retries through successful first local sign-in.

findings.issue: The rendered join starts from a fabricated token, mounts GuestPass directly, replaces the scanner, and mocks lookup/redeem. Separate API tests cover expiry, HMAC, and stored verify_code mismatch, but no recorded execution joins a server-generated pass to the real Share control, public bootstrap, decoded QR, and real gate validation.
findings.consequence: The complete live pass artifact and share-to-gate path remain unverified in context.
findings.correction: In a future authorized run, execute a real mobile routed story from live pass issue through Share, /pass fragment bootstrap, QR decode, and real lookup/redeem, including two-hour expiry and both tamper-rejection assertions.

findings.criterion: 3 and 4 — real camera plate scanning at check-in and check-out
findings.issue: Rendered tests replace LiveCamera with an already-decoded plate button. No recorded run executes getUserMedia, the shipped ONNX loader/decoder, a fixture, and responsive rendering; the real-camera script covers only check-in.
findings.consequence: Actual camera acquisition and plate decoding remain unverified in the shipped stack for check-in and check-out.
findings.correction: In a future authorized run, execute the 390x844 real-model fake-camera check-in story and add/run checkout coverage, asserting filled fields, match/result, stopped tracks, versions, and a clean console.

findings.criterion: 6 and 7 — complete real-stack CRUD and cross-property operations
findings.issue: Rendered CRUD tests mock every API and complete a full lifecycle only for a unit; person/site/slot and cross-property coverage is incomplete. The browser story has no recorded run and does not cover narrow-screen all-entity lifecycles or real regular-admin denial.
findings.consequence: Persisted administration, cross-property Super Admin operations, authorization boundaries, and narrow-screen usability remain unverified in context.
findings.correction: In a future authorized run, execute full person/site/unit/slot lifecycles through the real routed UI/API at a narrow viewport, perform representative all-entity second-property operations as Super Admin, and prove regular-admin server denial.
